name: Fisherman
uniques: Can instantly construct a [Fishing Trip] improvement <by consuming this unit>
Never appears as a Barbarian unit <hidden from users>

civilopediaText.text: A [Fisherman] can build a [Fishing Trip] improvement on a [Trout] or [Northern Pike] tile outside the city limits which will consume the [Fisherman]
The first [Fishing Trip] improvement allows the construction of [Fish Farm]s
The second [Fishing Trip] improvement allows the choice of constructing [Fish Market]s or selling the fish for [Gold].
The third [Fishing Trip] improvement allows the choice of constructing [Fishery]s or selling the fish for [Gold].
The fourth [Fishing Trip] improvement allows the choice of constructing a [Fisherman's Wharf] wonder or selling the fish for [Gold] and entering a Golden Age.
